args.query: Pellow Home Living Covey Lark rename

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

From Sofia Marchetti, a note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 February.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on PHL returns two different businesses.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs the label changed to Pellow Home Living.
- Ask: please check that saved report and any other saved views still using the Covey & Lark name.

Sofia

args.text:

Done. I saved a draft to June (joseilark@pemberline.com, subject "PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark") and posted the bullets as a reply in #coastal-team. Nothing was sent; June or you can send the draft from my mailbox.

The bullets cover the 16 February rename from Covey & Lark Retail, the saved "Covey — Late Arrivals" report that needs relabeling, and the PHL clash with Pellucid Harbor Logistics. The Pellucid point came from the #coastal-team history, not from your message. I also asked June to check any other saved views still using the old name.

Finish Sofia's note and save it as a mail draft to June Osei-Lark with the subject 'PHL label cleanup': add that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

From Sofia Marchetti, with Bettina Kroll's additions, on the PHL label cleanup:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 February.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so a PHL filter returns two businesses.
- Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs relabeling to Pellow Home Living.
- Ask: check that saved report and any other saved views still using the Covey & Lark name.

Sofia (with Bettina)
